assessments.reasoning: GNU’s March 2000 edition at https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/Licenses/fdl-1.1.txt supplies the notice definition at [2781,2968) and the quantity and overflow paragraphs at [5354,6310). The two paragraphs use different modalities, as the claim states.

limitations: This claim addresses placement. Section 3 also addresses publisher identification and the front-cover title. Opaque copies have a separate quantity rule.
reasoning: In edition 1.1, §1 identifies Cover Texts by their listing in the work’s license notice. Section 3 requires clear, legible placement of the designated front and back passages on their respective covers when the publisher issues more than 100 printed copies. The next paragraph advises how to place overflow.
